super6.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
super6.comment: €140,000 Earthlight colt. In top hands but has made a low-key start in 2 runs over 6f on turf this autumn.

Won a pair of handicap hurdles at Fairyhouse last season, travelling powerfully when scoring over 21f in April. Badly hampered here next time, before matching his hurdles form on chasing debut when fourth of 9 in maiden at Wexford (2m) 17 days ago. Merits consideration.

Useful winning hurdler who produced his best chase effort when second to Luimneach at Gowran on last month’s return, and he remains open to further progress over fences from a workable mark, particularly with a good-value conditional booked. Respected.

super6.race: Betfair Stayers' Red Rose Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Quirky sort but completed a handicap hat-trick around 3m when seeing off 4 rivals at Market Rasen (good to soft) last month. Creditable fourth of 14 over 25f at Aintree since but that underlines he needs a bit more off this mark.

super6.race: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series At Punchestown Festival 2027 Qualifier Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Maiden winner who is best excused both handicap hurdle outings to date, needing the run on return and possibly amiss when last seen in August. The yard is going much better now, though, and every chance she still has more to offer in this sphere with just a handful of outings under her belt.

super6.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Sergei Prokofiev filly was beaten long way out in a Thirsk maiden (5f) on sole start for Dylan Cunha back in May but shaped much better making her debut for this yard after a 5-month break when third of 9 in maiden at Catterick (5f, heavy) 25 days ago, not given an overly hard time. Should progress.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: €140,000 Earthlight colt. In top hands but has made a low-key start in 2 runs over 6f on turf this autumn.

finals.race: Betfair Exchange Graduation Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Smart novice chaser last season, culminating with a win in Grade 1 Manifesto at Aintree (2½m, good to soft) in April. Likely this 6-y-o has even more to offer this season. Hard to beat.

finals.race: Betfair Exchange Graduation Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Landed 25f Cheltenham novice on reappearance last season but couldn't add to his fine record fresh when down the field in 25f Aintree handicap 15 days ago. Back down in trip. Even a return to his best is unlikely to see him trouble Koktail Divin.

finals.race: Podkovan Won By A Czech Head Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Half-sister to smart hurdler Nemean Lion (15f-2½m winner). Modest winning stayer on the Flat this year. Ought to make a hurdler for capable yard, however, she'll probably be better off in low-grade handicaps.

finals.race: Conway Piling Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Won a pair of handicap hurdles at Fairyhouse last season, travelling powerfully when scoring over 21f in April. Badly hampered here next time, before matching his hurdles form on chasing debut when fourth of 9 in maiden at Wexford (2m) 17 days ago. Merits consideration.

finals.race: Conway Piling Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Fitted with tongue strap, showed improved form over hurdles when making all in 2m novice at Naas in March, impressing with his jumping. Wasn't able to dominate when well held in listed handicap at Fairyhouse next time, but he appeals as the type to make a chaser.

finals.race: Conway Piling Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Doubled his tally over hurdles in 24-runner handicap at this venue (2m) in May. Good second at Bellewstown (2½m) in August, but failed to see his race out in first-time cheekpieces when fifth of 13 here last month. Headgear discarded for chasing debut.

finals.race: Conway Piling Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Progressed well over hurdles during second half of last year for Declan Queally, winning 3 times including a listed novice at Cork (3m). However, he failed to come on for his chasing/stable debut when last of 9 in maiden at Wexford (2m) 17 days ago.

finals.race: Ladbrokes 1965 Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Good second in Kempton Grade 2 in January before suffering a pair of heavy defeats after, jumping erratically in the Ryanair at Cheltenham. Stuck to his task pretty well post-breathing operation when fourth over 25f at Aintree on reappearance and he can outrun his odds with that under his belt.

finals.race: Boodles Florida Pearl Novice Chase (Grade 2)
finals.comment: Useful hurdler who wasted no time matching that form over fences when winning a 2m maiden at Wexford 17 days ago. Should be suited by this step back up in trip and, with the yard in excellent form and further progress on the cards, he's one to take seriously.

finals.race: Boodles Florida Pearl Novice Chase (Grade 2)
finals.comment: Shaped well when 2¼ lengths second of 7 to Karl Des Tourelles in extended 2¼m novice at Galway on chasing debut. The longer trip is fine and he's clearly open to further progress, though this does represent a notable step up in grade.

finals.race: Betfair Supports Safer Gambling Week Newton Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Very impressive winner on bumper/hurdling debut respectively. More workmanlike when making it 2-2 over hurdles on return at Chepstow (2m), looking destined for longer trips in time. Still a highly promising start and another step forward ought to see him firmly in the mix on hat-trick bid.

finals.race: Betfair Supports Safer Gambling Week Newton Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Improved to win a Kilbeggan bumper second time up for Paul Traynor. Seen to maximum effect when justifying support on hurdling/stable debut at Perth (2m, soft) on return. Hat-trick likely beyond him in a hot race, even with his reappearance form working out well.

finals.race: Ryans Cleaning Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Developed into a useful handicap hurdler last season and looks open to significant improvement now back over fences on debut for new yard. Races from 2 lb out of the handicap but he's rated much higher over hurdles and a bold bid is expected.

finals.race: Ryans Cleaning Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Useful winning hurdler who produced his best chase effort when second to Luimneach at Gowran on last month’s return, and he remains open to further progress over fences from a workable mark, particularly with a good-value conditional booked. Respected.

finals.race: Best Odds On The Betfair Exchange Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Steadily progressive in handicaps last season. Runner-up in a solid C&D event prior to finishing 5 lengths fourth behind a couple of useful types at Aintree (2½m, good) in May. Still relatively lightly raced and there could be more to come with conditions to suit.

finals.race: Prancing To The Pilsner Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Made it 4 wins on the spin over hurdles in a 3-runner handicap at Sedgefield (17f, good) in September. That run of success came to an end with a whimper at Market Rasen last time, though.

finals.race: Ladbrokes Get Your Free Racing Bet Today Mares' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Fairly useful bumper/maiden winner. Highly tried couple of starts after dictating to score on handicap bow at Windsor in January. Better than she showed in her end-of-season defeat at Plumpton. Will be a fresher horse here and looks far from exposed on just her third handicap start.

finals.race: William Hill Morgiana Hurdle (Grade 1)
finals.comment: Useful dual-purpose performer. Best effort over hurdles when runner-up in Champion Novice here in April. Wasted a good opportunity to make a winning return in listed company at Down Royal last time. Plenty to find with Lossiemouth, even if back at the top of his game.

finals.race: Betfair Stayers' Red Rose Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Quirky sort but completed a handicap hat-trick around 3m when seeing off 4 rivals at Market Rasen (good to soft) last month. Creditable fourth of 14 over 25f at Aintree since but that underlines he needs a bit more off this mark.

finals.race: Betfair Stayers' Red Rose Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Polished display when fairly useful winner of Kelso novice in March. Made an encouraging return from 7 months off when 8 lengths third (Serious Chat length ahead in second) in 3m Ayr handicap (good to soft) 3 weeks ago, weakening as if the outing was needed.

finals.race: Restorations UK Berkshire National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Sketchy jumper but proved at least as good as ever when making a winning return at Ffos Las (3m) in October. Faces a more difficult task in this contest as he goes up in distance.

finals.race: Betfair Chase (Grade 1) (Registered As The Lancashire Chase) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Produced a big career best when making all in the Grade 1 Savills Chase at Leopardstown last Christmas. His subsequent run in the Irish Gold Cup can be excused (lame) and he'll be a threat to Grey Dawning if returning at the top of his game.

finals.race: Betfair Chase (Grade 1) (Registered As The Lancashire Chase) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Snapped a near 2-year losing run when easily seeing off 3 rivals in a Grade 3 at Punchestown (23f, good to soft) 38 days ago, typically impressing with some slick jumping. A big career best will likely be needed for him to follow up here, though.

finals.race: Vietti Barolo Hurst Park Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: In good form last autumn, making the frame in this race, but ended the campaign on a low-key note. However, there were better signs when fifth of 11 in race won by Vanderpoel here 3 weeks ago. 4 lb out of the weights but is still on a handy mark with cheekpieces refitted.

finals.race: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series At Punchestown Festival 2027 Qualifier Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Maiden winner who is best excused both handicap hurdle outings to date, needing the run on return and possibly amiss when last seen in August. The yard is going much better now, though, and every chance she still has more to offer in this sphere with just a handful of outings under her belt.

finals.race: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
Betfair Backs Opinions Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Fairly useful hurdle/chase winner (all 3 victories on soft). Advanced his form when chasing home a now-smart type on reappearance in this corresponding event last season. Better than beaten distance when last seen here in April, too, and he's one of the likelier types if his jumping holds up.

finals.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
finals.comment: In excellent hands but shown just modest form in qualifying for a mark. Now makes handicap debut having had a breathing operation during 131 days off so there could be progress to come upped in trip.

finals.race: WTW Willis (Pro/Am) Flat Race
finals.comment: Goliath Du Berlais gelding who was well backed and offered something to work on when second of 5 in 2m bumper at Ballinrobe on debut in September. Entitled to do better but longer trips later on likely to be more his thing.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Foaled April 11. 7,000 gns foal, Lope Y Fernandez filly. Half-sister to 2-y-o 6f winner Ingenuity and 2-y-o 6f winner Onaraggatip. Dam 5f-1m winner. Market for clues.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
finals.comment: Barely bettered poor form across 3 qualifying runs (trained by Charlie Johnston on first 2) but produced an improved effort to spring a surprise on nursery debut at this course (7f) 15 days ago. Shouldn't have an issue with the longer trip and she makes appeal again after 4 lb rise.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
finals.comment: Much improved when third of 10 on nursery debut over C&D at the start of October but was never a threat when sixth of 10 in a similar event 15 days ago. Pedigree suggests he should stay this additional 1f.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Showed promise amidst inexperience when fourth of 15 in maiden at Newbury on debut, faring best of the group that raced near side. Progressed when second of 8 in novice at Goodwood (6f, good to soft) 41 days ago and he still sets the standard, for all drop back to 5f isn't an obvious positive.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Sergei Prokofiev filly was beaten long way out in a Thirsk maiden (5f) on sole start for Dylan Cunha back in May but shaped much better making her debut for this yard after a 5-month break when third of 9 in maiden at Catterick (5f, heavy) 25 days ago, not given an overly hard time. Should progress.
